description: Skills from SaarthiOS. Contract review that reads an agreement from your side, scores it, and redlines it as tracked changes with threaded comments.

plugins.name: contract-review
plugins.description: Review an NDA, MSA, DPA, employment, or licensing agreement from ONE party's side; score how balanced it is; produce a clause-by-clause redline; then regenerate the original .docx with tracked changes and native comments authored as you, threading onto and resolving any existing comments.
